desc: MELON-PULT stage0: actual GREEN oval watermelon body with pale yellow-green wavy longitudinal stripes, deep dark green broad root leaves, TWO black oval eyes under heavy V-shaped MAD leafy brows. This project stage must stay MAD in all awake poses, even cheer (determined pleased squint, not friendly eyebrows); never add a mouth. Short ochre-green curled vine spring behind joins green half-watermelon cup with thin pale rind and red inside. Upright whole green striped melon payload sits in cup. Keep natural watermelon skin not cabbage leaves. Not a round generic green head.

WINTER MELON stage1: exact actual canonical icy CYAN/ICE-BLUE horizontal oval melon body with darker turquoise wavy stripes and glossy cool highlight, friendly calm black oval eyes under relaxed blue brows, NO MOUTH. Blue-green broad basal leaves. Blue curling vine coil spring connects rear to a CYAN half-melon cup with prominent jagged icy rim, carrying one upright blue striped melon payload. Winter anatomy is distinctly cyan/blue, NOT merely green recolor or white snow hat. Match actual game's ice-cut bowl geometry. No angry V-brow except momentary squint during hurt.

MEGA WINTER MELON stage2: natural final evolved extension of actual Winter Melon. Broader large ICY CYAN oval melon body with darker blue/turquoise longitudinal stripes, friendly calm black oval eyes, NO MOUTH; broad layered blue-green root leaves. Sturdier blue curled VINE COIL SPRING and larger icy half-melon BOWL CUP with angular crystalline rim, carrying ONE upright large blue striped melon payload. Add restrained crystalline facets on bowl rim and leaf tips, not a crown, armored robot, humanoid king or wooden cart. Strong larger silhouette but recognizable actual Winter Melon geometry. Keep eyes relaxed, friendly and readable.
